scripts.diagnostics.lua:
return function(ctx)
  if ctx.request.trigger == 'close' then return {result='closed'} end
  local items, offset = {}, 0
  for line in (ctx.document.text .. '\n'):gmatch('(.-)\n') do
    local start = line:find('[ \t]+\r?$')
    if start and #items < 128 then
      local finish = offset + #line
      if line:sub(-1) == '\r' then finish = finish - 1 end
      local edit = hedit.transaction({hedit.edit(offset + start - 1, finish, '')})
      items[#items+1] = {range={start=offset+start-1,finish=finish},severity='warning',message='Trailing whitespace',actions={{title='Remove trailing whitespace',action={edit=edit}}}}
    end
    offset = offset + #line + 1
  end
  ctx.cache.calls = (ctx.cache.calls or 0) + 1
  return {cache=ctx.cache,result={diagnostics=items}}
end
scripts.navigation.lua:
return function(ctx)
  local items, offset = {}, 0
  for line in (ctx.document.text .. '\n'):gmatch('(.-)\n') do
    local title = line:match('^#+%s+(.+)')
    if title and #items < 128 then items[#items+1]={title=title,action={select={anchor=offset,head=offset+#line}}} end
    offset = offset + #line + 1
  end
  return {result={presentation={status=('Found %d headings'):format(#items),quick_list={title='Document headings',items=items}}}}
end
